title: Camcorder
description: herb's Times Square night through a 2000s camcorder viewfinder, with STBY, battery, date stamp and timecode on screen. Drag to aim and the hand-held picture lags, combs and hunts for focus; rock W–T to zoom until the digital zoom goes blocky, press Record, then play the clip back off the tape with tracking lines.
intent: The imperfect home-video look of herb's references, made by the camera itself: auto-exposure that lags when you swing to the bright signs, focus that hunts after a zoom, interlaced combing on fast pans, and a real record and playback loop.
sources: herb reference board: handheld lo-fi night footage (95d9, 7af8, 859f, 899734)
